y-m-36-02.title: Ukwazi impande eyodwa kumisa ama-coefficient?
y-m-36-02.topic: Impande eyodwa yesibalo se-quadratic nolwazi oludingekayo ukunquma ama-coefficient
y-m-36-02.goal: Sebenza ukuthi izingaki ama-coefficient ulwazi "impande eyodwa inikeziwe" olumisa, khetha ulwazi olwengeziwe olwanele ukumisa ama-coefficient abe impendulo eyodwa, bese wakha wena isibonelo esihlangabezana nemibandela.
y-m-36-02.material: Kusibalo se-quadratic x² + ax + b = 0 (a no-b kuyizinombolo zangempela), konke okwaziwayo ukuthi x = 2 iyimpande. USoyeong uthe, "Uma ufaka u-x = 2, ungathola a no-b," noDaon uthe, "Lokho kuphela akulona ulwazi olwanele." (Ifundwa: x squared kanye no-a x kanye no-b kulingana no-0)
y-m-36-02.thinking.0: Ukuqhathanisa inani lolwazi (inani lezibalo) nenani lezimbumbulu ezingaziwa ukuthola
y-m-36-02.thinking.1: Hlola ngamunye ukuthi ulwazi olwengeziwe lwanele yini
y-m-36-02.thinking.2: Yakha isibonelo esihlangabezana nayo yonke imibandela
y-m-36-02.prereq.0: Incazelo yempande yesibalo (ukufaka impande kwenza isibalo siyiqiniso)
y-m-36-02.prereq.1: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezimpande ezimbili zesibalo se-quadratic nama-coefficient aso (izinga lesigaba sezibalo seBanga 10) — I-H2 yalo msebenzi iwukuthi kuphela izinga lobunzima nokusekelwa kule nkululeko yokukhiqiza; ayisho ukuthi uhlelo lwezifundo lunikeza leso sifundo kuleli banga. Cabanga ukuthi ulwazi olumele lwangaphambilini olungezansi selufundiwe.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.prompt: Qhathanisa lokho uSoyeong noDaon abakushilo, bese ukhetha isahlulelo esifaneleka kakhulu ngolwazi olwaziwayo okwamanje.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.hint.0: Faka a = 0, 1, −1 eyodwa ngesikhathi, bese ulungisa b ukuze x = 2 ibe yimpande.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi onke amapheya owenzile ahlangabezana nemibandela yini. Uma kunjalo, kunezimpendulo ezingaki?
y-m-36-02.s.s1.o.a: Isibalo esisodwa ositholayo ngokufaka u-x = 2 sikuvumela ukuthi uthole kokubili a no-b.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu kuthatha isibalo esisodwa njengesingakwazi ukumisa izimbumbulu ezingaziwa ezimbili. Zama ukuthola ukuthi b iba yini uma a ingu-0, 1, no-−1.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.o.b: Uma x = 2 iyimpande, khona-ke b kumele ibe ngu-0.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.r.b: Awuhlolanga ukuthi likhona yini isizathu sokuthi b ibe ngu-0 uma impande ingeyona u-0. Thola b uma a = 0.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.o.c: Njengoba kunikezwe impande eyodwa kuphela, lesi sibalo kumele sibe nempande ephindwe kabili.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.r.c: Lesi sahlulelo sithatha "impande eyodwa eyaziwayo" no-"impande eyodwa kuphela" njengento efanayo. Thola zonke izimpande uma a = −1.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.o.d: Ukufaka kunika isibalo esisodwa kuphela, ngakho a no-b azikwazi ukumiswa zibe impendulo eyodwa.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.r.d: Lesi sahlulelo siqhathanisa inani lezimbumbulu ezingaziwa nenani lezibalo ezitholakele.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.explain: Ukufaka u-x = 2 kunika isibalo esisodwa, 4 + 2a + b = 0. Kunezimbumbulu ezingaziwa ezimbili, a no-b, ngakho amapheya angapheli ayenzeka, njengo-(a, b) = (0, −4), (−1, −2), (1, −6). Ukuthi impande eyodwa inikeziwe akusho ukuthi enye impande inenani elifanayo.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.prompt: Ake sithi ngamunye unikeziwe ngokwehlukana. Khetha lonke ulwazi olwengeziwe olwanele ukumisa a no-b zibe impendulo eyodwa.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kukhetho ngalunye, bhala ulwazi olusha njengesibalo bese usixazulula ndawonye nesibalo osenaso, 4 + 2a + b = 0, bese ubala ukuthi mangaki amapheya (a, b) aphumayo.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ezinketho ezingamisi impendulo, hlola ngokwakha amapheya amabili ahlukene ahlangabezana nombandela.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.a: Uhlolile ukuthi ukwazi zombili izimpande kumisa kokubili a no-b ngesamba nomphumela.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.b: Lesi sinqumo sihlola ukuthi ungathola yini b ngokuyihlanganisa nesibalo osinaso kakade, 4 + 2a + b = 0.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.c: Awubalanga ukuthi umbandela wezinombolo ezigcwele ushiya amapheya amangaki afeza 4 + 2a + b = 0. (0, −4) no-(−2, 0) kuyamapheya ezinombolo ezigcwele.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.d: Awuhlukanisanga ulwazi olunciphisa ibanga nolwazi olunquma impendulo eyodwa. Kunamapheya amaningi (a, b) afeza lo mbandela nawo.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.e: Lesi sinqumo sihlola ukuthi ubudlelwano obusanda kunikezwa, kanye nesibalo sokuqala, benza izibalo ezimbili yini.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.explain: Uma enye impande ingu-−3, khona-ke isamba −1 = −a nomphumela −6 = b kuzinqumela. Uma a = −1, khona-ke b = −2. Uma b = a + 2, khona-ke 4 + 2a + a + 2 = 0 kunika a = −2, b = 0. Umbandela wezinombolo ezigcwele nombandela we-"zinombolo zangempela ezihlukile" unciphisa ibanga kuphela, futhi amapheya amaningana asala.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.prompt: Kulesi sikhathi, yenza amapheya amabili ahlukile (a, b) lapho a no-b kuyizinombolo ezigcwele futhi izimpande ezimbili ze-x² + ax + b = 0 ziyizinombolo zangempela eziphozithivu ezihlukile, elilodwa lazo lingu-2.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qala usebenzise 4 + 2a + b = 0 ukufanisa b no-a, bese ubhala nge-a ukuthi enye impande iyini.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.hint.1: Zama amanani amaningana ka-a ukuze enye impande ibe yiphozithivu futhi ingabi ngu-2.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.fail.c1: Sicela wenze a no-b zibe yizinombolo ezigcwele.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.fail.c2: Uma ufaka x = 2, isibalo asiba ngu-0.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.ok.c3: Enye impande iyinombolo ephozithivu engeyona u-2.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.fail.c3: Enye impande ayiyona iphozithivu noma ilingana no-2, ngakho ayinikezi "izimpande ezimbili eziphozithivu ezihlukile."
y-m-36-02.s.s3.explain: Isibonelo, (a, b) = (−3, 2) inika x² − 3x + 2 = (x − 1)(x − 2), ngezimpande 1 no-2, futhi (−5, 6) inika izimpande 2 no-3. (−4, 4) inempande eyodwa kuphela, 2 (impande ephindwe kabili), futhi (−1, −2) inenye impande −1, ngakho akukho okufanela imibandela. Amapheya amaningi afeza yonke le mibandela, ngakho ungaqinisekisa futhi ukuthi imibandela ayinqumi impendulo eyodwa.

y-m-36-09.title: Isibalo se-quadratic isamba nomkhiqizo wacho kuyiphozithivu
y-m-36-09.topic: Izimpawu zezimpande ezimbili zesibalo se-quadratic nezimo ezisambeni nasemkhiqizweni
y-m-36-09.goal: Thola isimo esishodayo esimangalweni esithi "uma isamba nomkhiqizo kuyiphozithivu, zombili izimpande ziyiphozithivu" ngokwakha isibonelo esiphikisayo wena, bese ulungisa isimangalo ukuze sibe yiqiniso.
y-m-36-09.material: UMina wenze isimangalo: "Esibalweni se-quadratic x² − sx + q = 0 (s no-q ziyizinombolo zangempela), uma isamba s nomkhiqizo q wezimpande ezimbili kuyiphozithivu, khona zombili izimpande ziyizinombolo zangempela eziyiphozithivu." (Funda njenge: x squared minus s x plus q equals 0) Isamba sezimpande ezimbili singu-s futhi umkhiqizo ungu-q.

y-m-36-09.thinking.1: Yakha isibonelo esiphikisayo esanelisa isimo kodwa siphula isiphetho
y-m-36-09.thinking.2: Lungisa isimangalo ngokwengeza isimo lapho sibamba khona

y-m-36-09.s.s1.o.c: Kuhlala kubamba. Uma isamba nomkhiqizo kuyiphozithivu, zombili izimpande ziyiphozithivu.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.r.c: Awuhlolanga izibonelo eziphikisayo ukubona ukuthi izimpawu zesamba nomkhiqizo kuphela zanele yini.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.o.d: Kungase kungabambi. Kukhona izimo lapho izimpande zingezona zangempela.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.r.d: Uhlole ingcabango yokuthi izimpande kumele zibe zangempela ukuze izimpawu zesamba nomkhiqizo zisitshele izimpawu zezimpande.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.explain: Uma umkhiqizo uyiphozithivu futhi zombili izimpande zangempela, izimpande ezimbili zinophawu olufanayo, futhi uma isamba siyiphozithivu, zombili ziyiphozithivu. Kodwa uma izimpande zingezona zangempela, okungukuthi, izimpande ezingekho zangempela, igama elithi "uphawu" alikwazi ukusetshenziswa, futhi isamba nomkhiqizo kusengaba yiphozithivu. Isibonelo, izimpande ze-x² − 2x + 5 = 0 zingu-1 ± 2i.
y-m-36-09.s.s2.prompt: Yenza amabhanqa amabili ahlukene (s, q) aphula isimangalo sikaMina. Isamba s nomkhiqizo q kuyiphozithivu kokubili, kodwa izimpande ezimbili zesibalo x² − sx + q = 0 akumele ziyizinombolo zangempela eziyiphozithivu.

(5, 6) inezimpande zangempela eziyiphozithivu ezingu-2 no-3, futhi (4, 4) inempande eyodwa kuphela, u-2 (impande ephindwe kabili), okuyinombolo yangempela eyiphozithivu, ngakho akukho kwazo okuphula isimangalo. y-m-36-09.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi yisiphi isimo esingahlunga lesi sibonelo esiphikisayo ngenkathi sishiya izimo zesamba nomkhiqizo njengoba zinjalo.

y-m-36-08.title: Yisiphi kwezixazululo ezimbili esizoqhubeka siwusizo?
y-m-36-08.topic: Izimpande eziphelele zesibalo se-cubic nokuqhathanisa izindlela zokuxazulula
y-m-36-08.goal: Qhathanisa izindlela ezimbili zokuxazulula, hlola ukuthi ngaphansi kwazimo ziphi ngayinye ingasetshenziswa, futhi wenze uhlelo lokuxazulula ngokwakha wena isibalo se-cubic esinezimpande eziphelele.
y-m-36-08.material: UHajun noSeoyun baxazulula isibalo se-cubic u-x³ − 2x² − x + 2 = 0. UHajun: wahlanganisa amagama amabili okuqala namagama amabili okugcina futhi wayishintsha yaba ngu-x²(x − 2) − (x − 2) = (x − 2)(x² − 1). USeoyun: wafaka u-x = 1, waqinisekisa ukuthi unika u-0, futhi wahlukanisa ngo-x − 1 ukuthola u-(x − 1)(x² − x − 2). Bobabili bathola izimpande u-−1, 1, 2. (Funda ngokuthi: x cubed minus 2x squared minus x plus 2 equals 0)
y-m-36-08.thinking.0: Qhathanisa futhi uhlole izindlela zokuxazulula komunye nomunye
y-m-36-08.thinking.1: Hlulela ukuthi indlela ingaqhubeka isetshenziswa yini lapho izimo zishintsha
y-m-36-08.prereq.0: Ithiyori yesici nokuhlukanisa okuhlanganisiwe (ukuhlukanisa i-polynomial ngesisho somugqa)
y-m-36-08.prereq.1: Iqiniso lokuthi abantu abangaba nguwo bezimpande eziphelele zesibalo esinama-coefficient aphelele bayizihlukanisi zegama eliqhubekayo (izinga lenyunithi yezibalo yebanga 10) — U-H2 walo msebenzi uyizinga kuphela lobunzima nokusekela ekwabiweni kwalokhu kukhiqizwa; akusho ukuthi ikharikhulamu inika leso sihloko leli banga. Cabanga ukuthi ulwazi oludingekayo olungezansi selufundiwe.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.prompt: Yiluphi uhlolo olufaneleke kakhulu oluqhathanisa izixazululo ezimbili?
y-m-36-08.s.s1.hint.0: Kokubili izixazululo ezimbili, bhala umugqa owodwa ngokuthi yisiphi isici senkinga (ifomu lesisho, igama eliqhubekayo) esisisebenzisile.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi isixazululo ngasinye singaqhubeka sisetshenziswa yini uma esinye sezici ezimbili sinyamalala.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.o.a: Isixazululo sikaHajun kuphela esilungile. USeoyun ube nenhlanhla nje yokuthi u-x = 1 ube yimpande.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.r.a: Lesi sahlulelo sithatha ukuthola izimpande ngokufaka njengokungathenjwa.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.o.b: Isixazululo sikaSeoyun kuphela esilungile. Ukuhlanganisa kuyinkohliso esebenza kule nkinga kuphela.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.r.b: Ubheke kuphela ububanzi lapho indlela eyodwa isebenza khona futhi wabhekisa eceleni enye.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.o.c: Zombili ziyavumelana, futhi imikhondo ngayinye eyisebenzisile ihlukile.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.r.c: Uhlukanise ukuthi izindlela ezimbili zisebenzisa imikhondo ehlukile.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.o.d: Izimpendulo ziyafana, ngakho akukho mqondo ekuhloleni izindlela ngokuhlukile.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.r.d: Awuhlukanisanga iqiniso lokuthi izimpendulo ziyafana nokuthi indlela ijwayelekile kangakanani.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.explain: UHajun usebenzise isakhiwo lapho isisho singahlelwa ngokuqoqa, futhi uSeoyun usebenzise izihlukanisi zenkathi engaguquki njengabaqokelwa ukuthola impande. Zombili ziyizibalo ezilungile, futhi izimo ezisebenzisayo zihlukile. Le nkinga yanelisa zombili izimo, ngakho zombili zasebenza.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.prompt: Shintsha inkathi engaguquki ukuze isibalo sibe ngu-x³ − 2x² − x + 3 = 0. Yisiphi isitatimende esilungile ngalesi sisho?
y-m-36-08.s.s2.hint.0: Faka x = 1, −1, 3, −3 bese ubala inani lesisho ngalinye.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi izimpawu zenani lesisho zihluka kanjani ku-x = −2 no-x = −1.

y-m-36-08.s.s2.r.a: Awubhalanga ngempela ukuthi isici esivamile sisala ngempela ngemva kokuqoqa yini. Hlola ukuthi izinkathi ezimbili zokugcina ziyi-−x + 3.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.o.b: Ukufaka ±1, ±3 kunikeza amanani wonke angeyona u-0, ngakho akukho mpande eyinombolo ephelele.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.r.b: Uhlukanise ukuthi indlela yokuzama bonke abaqokelwa abayizinombolo eziphelele ingakutshela kangakanani.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.o.c: Akukho mpande eyinombolo ephelele, ngakho lesi sibalo asinaso isixazululo futhi ukuxazulula sekuphelile.

y-m-36-08.s.s2.o.d: Akukho kuqoqa noma ukufaka okusebenzayo, ngakho lesi sibalo asikwazi ukuxazululwa.

y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Inkinga ayisho ukuthi p no-q ziyizinombolo zangempela, kodwa kungenzeka uzicabangile kanjalo. Uma usebenzise isiqagelo, kuhle ukusibhala phansi.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Akukho lwazi ngo-p no-q, ngakho ayikwazi ukunqunywa.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Awusiqageli isiqagelo esingaphiwanga futhi wabambezela isinqumo sakho.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kungenzeka ucabange umthetho wokuguqula zonke izimpawu. Kuze kube yilapho uhlola isamba nomphumela wena, alukho isisekelo salokho.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Iyimpande ephindwe kabili, efanayo no-1 + i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Lesi sinqumo sithatha "impande eyodwa iyaziwa" no-"izimpande ziyalingana" njengokufanayo.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Ulwazi olusha: p no-q kokubili ziyizinombolo zangempela. Uma enye impande ingu-s + ti (s no-t kuyizinombolo zangempela), isamba sezimpande ezimbili (1 + s) + (1 + t)i nomphumela (s − t) + (s + t)i kufanele kube yizinombolo zangempela kokubili. (Umphumela ungu-(1 + i)(s + ti) = s + ti + si + ti² uyenziwe lula.)
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Ukuze isamba sibe sangempela, 1 + t = 0, ngakho t = −1, futhi ukuze umphumela ube wangempela, s + t = 0, ngakho s = 1. Ngakho enye impande ingu-1 − i. Isinqumo sangaphambilini sokuthi ayikwazi ukunqunywa bekulungile ngoba ulwazi lwalungenele, futhi manje sishintshile ngoba ulwazi lwanda.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ufanise kuphela ingxenye engeyona yangempela ukuze isamba sibe sangempela futhi awuhlolanga umphumela. Bala ukuthi umphumela uwowangempela yini.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uma izimpande ezimbili ziyalingana, isamba 2 + 2i asiyona inombolo yangempela. Hlola ukuthi isamba singesangempela yini.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ulwazi olusha lunika izibalo ezimbili, isamba nomphumela, kodwa uqhubekile ubambezela isinqumo sakho njengakuqala.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Leli yinani olithola ngokuthola s no-t ezenza isamba nomphumela kube okwangempela.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Sishintsha ucezu olulodwa lolwazi. Kulesi sikhathi, sishiya isitatimende sokuthi p no-q ziyizinombolo zangempela, futhi sithi enye impande ingu-2. Khona-ke x² + px + q = (x − (1 + i))(x − 2) = x² − (3 + i)x + (2 + 2i), ngakho p = −3 − i no-q = 2 + 2i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Kulesi sibonelo, p = −3 − i no-q = 2 + 2i akuyona izinombolo zangempela, ngakho licala elingaphandle kwesiqagelo sokuthi "ama-coefficient angempela." Ngaphandle kwalesi siqagelo, awukwazi ukusho ukuthi impande eyodwa 1 + i yodwa yenza enye impande ibe ngu-1 − i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ngaphandle kwesiqagelo sokuthi p no-q ziyizinombolo zangempela, awukwazi ukusho ukuthi enye impande ingu-1 − i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wehlukanise ukuthi yisiphi isiqagelo isici sempande ehlangene esimi kusona.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Uma impande eyodwa ingu-1 + i, enye impande ihlala ingu-1 − i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Bheka futhi ukuthi enye impande iyini esibonelweni esisanda kwenziwa.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Izimpande zesibalo se-quadratic zihlala zinombolo eyodwa yangempela nenye engeyona yangempela.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Izimpande ezimbili 1 + i no-2 kulesi sibonelo zingabukeka njengepheya elinjalo, kodwa uhlobo lwezimpande luncike kuma-coefficient. Cabanga ngecala lapho zombili izimpande ziyizangempela uma ama-coefficient eyizangempela.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Noma p no-q ziyizangempela, enye impande ingase ingabi ngu-1 − i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: P no-q kulesi sibonelo aziyona izangempela. Hlola ukuthi isibonelo senziwe ngaphansi kwemibandela yini.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.info: Ucezu lokugcina lolwazi: futhi p no-q ziyizangempela, kodwa kulesi sikhathi impande eyodwa ingu-1 + √2, okungeyona engeyona yangempela. Isibonelo, uma enye impande ingu-3, khona-ke (x − (1 + √2))(x − 3) = x² − (4 + √2)x + 3 + 3√2, futhi lapha p = −4 − √2 no-q = 3 + 3√2 zombili ziyizangempela.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.after: Umbandela wokuthi p no-q ziyizangempela wodwa awunquli enye impande ibe ngu-1 − √2. U-1 − √2 uqinisekiswa kuphela uma kunombandela onamandla wokuthi p no-q ziyizinombolo ezinengxenyana.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.o.a: Uma p no-q ziyizangempela, ihlala ingu-1 − √2.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Bheka ukuthi enye impande iyini esibonelweni esisanda kunikezwa.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.o.b: Kufanele ibe yimpande ephindwe kabili, efanayo no-1 + √2.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Lesi sinqumo sithatha "impande eyodwa iyaziwa" no-"impande ephindwe kabili" njengokufanayo.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Uthwale umthetho osetshenziselwa izimpande ezingeyona izangempela, ushintsha uphawu kuphela. Hlola isamba nomphumela.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.o.d: Ayikwazi ukunqunywa. Noma enye impande ingu-3, p no-q ziyizangempela.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.r.d: Uqinisekise ngesibonelo ukuthi umbandela wama-coefficient angempela wodwa awanele.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni kwakungekho lwazi, ngakho "ayikwazi ukunqunywa" kwakuyisinqumo esilungile, futhi lapho kufika ulwazi lokuthi "p no-q ziyizangempela," isinqumo sashintsha saba ngu-1 − i. Ezinyathelweni ezimbili ezilandelayo, uhlole ngezibonelo ukuthi ngaphansi kwemibandela yini umthetho ofanayo uyaphuka. Buyekeza ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi olufikile nokuthi yisiphi isinqumo esashintsha, noma ukuthi bekuhle yini ukuqhubeka njengoba kunjalo.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.prompt: Khetha wonke amacala lapho "enye impande inqunywa ngokuqinisekile njengesihlangene (ifomu elinophawu kuphela elishintshiwe)."
y-m-36-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kukhetho ngalunye, khetha ngokukhululeka enye impande eyodwa, bese uhlola ukuthi p no-q manje ziyafeza umbandela wokukhetha.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ukhetho lapho ngisho nesibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo esifeza umbandela singakhiwa akulona "ngokuqinisekile."
y-m-36-03.s.s2.o.a: Impande eyodwa yesibalo se-quadratic onke ama-coefficient aso ayizangempela ingu-3 − 2i
y-m-36-03.s.s2.r.a: Uhlolile ukuthi zombili izimo ziyabakhona: impande engeyona yangempela inikeziwe futhi ama-coefficient ayizangempela.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.o.b: Impande eyodwa yesibalo se-quadratic ama-coefficient aso ayizinombolo ze-complex ingu-3 − 2i
y-m-36-03.s.s2.r.b: Khumbula isibonelo esiphikisayo sesinyathelo esedlule, bese ucabanga ukuthi lo mthetho uqinisekisiwe yini uma kungekho siqagelo sokuthi ama-coefficient ayizangempela.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.o.c: Impande eyodwa yesibalo se-quadratic onke ama-coefficient aso ayizinombolo ezinengxenyana ingu-2 + √3
y-m-36-03.s.s2.r.c: Lesi sinqumo sehlukanisa ukuthi yimuphi umbandela kuma-coefficient odingekayo ukuze umthetho usebenze nakwizimpande zangempela.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.o.d: Impande eyodwa yesibalo se-quadratic onke ama-coefficient aso ayizangempela ingu-2 + √3
y-m-36-03.s.s2.r.d: Lesi sinqumo sithatha imibandela edingekayo ezimpandeni ezingeyona izangempela nezimpande ezingenakwenziwa ngengxenyana njengokufanayo. Cabanga ngesibonelo lapho enye impande ingu-3.
y-m-36-03.s.s2.explain: Impande engeyona yangempela yesibalo se-quadratic esinama-coefficient angempela ivela kanye nesihlangene sayo, futhi impande 2 + √3 yesibalo se-quadratic esinama-coefficient anezinombolo ezinengxenyana ivela kanye no-2 − √3. Uma ama-coefficient eyizinombolo ze-complex, noma eyizangempela kuphela, impande engenakwenziwa ngengxenyana ayikuvumeli ukuthi unqume enye impande njengesihlangene sayo.

y-m-36-05.title: Ibanga lika-k elisebenza kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela x
y-m-36-05.topic: Umbandela wokuthi ukungalingani kwe-quadratic kubambe kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela, nenani lomkhawulo
y-m-36-05.goal: Hlukanisa ukuthi umphumela wokuhlola amanani ambalwa ubufakazi noma ubufakazi obuphelele, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi ukuthi inani lomkhawulo lifakiwe yini kuyashintsha kuye ngokuthi uphawu lokungalingani lungu-> noma ≥.
y-m-36-05.material: Nquma esinyathelweni ngesinyathelo ibanga lika-k lapho ukungalingani x² − 4x + k > 0 kubamba kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela x. (Funda: x ngesikwele kususwe 4x kwengeziwe k kukhulu kuno-0) Ucezu olulodwa lolwazi lunikezwa njalo.

y-m-36-05.s.s1.hint.0: Faka inani lomkhawulo lika-k ngqo esibalweni, ulibhale ngefomu (x − 2)², bese uhlola inani laso ku-x = 2.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.hint.1: Faka inani elifanayo lika-k ecaleni le-> nasecaleni le-≥ bese uqhathanisa ukuthi ngalinye liyabamba yini.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Nge-k = 5, ukufaka x = −1, 0, 2, 3, 6 kunike amanani esibalo 10, 5, 1, 2, 17 ngokulandelana, wonke eyiphozithivu.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Amanani amahlanu angubufakazi obuhle, kodwa akuyona ukuhlola zonke izinombolo zangempela. Uma wazi isimo sesibalo (inani elincane kakhulu lalesi sibalo), ungaqiniseka, futhi lesi sibalo sinenani laso elincane kakhulu, 1, ku-x = 2, ngakho k = 5 isebenza ngempela.

y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Lesi sinqumo asikabheki ukuhlukana phakathi kwamaphoyinti angu-5 ahloliwe nazo zonke izinombolo zangempela.

y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Awuzange ucabangele ukuthi uphawu lokungalingani luhlukile kokungalingani kwangaphambilini.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.o.c: Asikwazi ukusho ukuthi ukhona yini. Ekungalinganini kwe-quadratic, kufanele njalo ukuxazulule kabusha lapho uphawu lushintsha.

y-m-36-05.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni kwakunengqondo ukungaqiniseki ngamanani ambalwa, bese ukufaka inani lomkhawulo ngqo kwaqinisekisa ukuthi lifakiwe yini, futhi lapho uphawu lokungalingani lushintsha, isahlulelo senani lomkhawulo elifanayo sashintsha. y-m-36-05.s.s2.hint.0: Faka u-x = 3 futhi uveze inani lesisho ngo-k. Cabanga ukuthi leli nani liyiphoyinti eliphakeme kakhulu kugrafu yini.

y-m-36-06.title: Ukuthola u-k ukuze kube nezixazululo eziphelele eziyisikhombisa
